svg.title: My Hermes Agent Setup
svg.desc: Architecture diagram of My Hermes Agent Setup: a stick figure labeled me uses Discord and SSH; a self-hosted Linux box runs the Hermes Gateway, coding agents, Hermes, Honcho, and Obsidian integration; external systems provide inference and cloud infrastructure.
svg.text: One self-hosted Linux box runs Hermes, its Gateway, coding agents, and memory connections.
Host: any always-on Linux machine · hardware and distribution are interchangeable

g.text: conversation and execution in one place
